content.text:
I fixed two CSS bugs in `site/css/styles.css`, and both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass against the approved screenshots.

1. **Navbar contents were hidden.** The `.navbar > .container` rule had `display: none`, so the brand and links disappeared. The navbar shrank to 16px tall and the page content moved up. I changed it back to `display: flex`.
2. **Dropdown caret was too wide.** The `.dropdown-toggle::after` rule had `border-right: 0.45em`, which made the caret asymmetric and pushed the nav links about 3px to the left on desktop. I changed it back to `0.3em`.

The repo has only the initial commit, so I couldn't see what the last change was. I found both problems by comparing the screenshots with the CSS.

Git also shows some untracked files I didn't create or touch: `.idea`, `.vscode`, `site/.mcp.json`, `site/css/.claude/` and `site/css/.mcp.json`. I left them alone.

STATUS: DONE
